'''Clezo''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] of the [[Chattza clan/Legends|Chattza clan]] and [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] during the time of [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]]. 
==History==
Clezo was member of the ruling [[Chattza clan/Legends|Chattza clan]] of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] and controlled many criminal activities on his [[homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="sb" />

He provided for several [[bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunting]] groups, such as the [[Granse Confederacy]] and the [[House Tresario]] of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]]; the latter also provided contacts with the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], to which it was affiliated. Clezo's organization operated a "safari outfitting" service through which he could employ bounty hunters for Black Sun.<ref name="sb" />

Clezo was a Vigo around the same time as [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] under [[Dal Perhi]]; he witnessed as the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Dark Prince]] succeeded him to the position of [[Underlord]], and became Clezo's master.<ref name="sb" />

[[Chorh-dha]], belonged both to Clezo's and Vigo [[Green]]'s organizations; he reported to Clezo Green's activities.<ref name="sb" /> Although he knew Green's treacherous plans, he did not inform anyone.<ref name="obvious" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], he was also one of [[Grand Protector/Legends|Grand Protector]] [[Navik/Legends|Navik the Red's]] [[clan]]-servants, through whom Navik hoped to keep an eye on Black Sun's activities.<ref>''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref> Clezo however expected Navik's [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]], and putting Chorh-da in his place as the clan's [[Chief Protector]], operating as Black Sun's puppet; this would bring more control on their homeworld for their organization.<ref name="sb" />

Another of Clezo's underlings was [[Avaro Sookcool]], who, however, also had direct channels to Xizor.<ref name="sb" />

[[Guri]] had asked him to employ some to locate [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] (and subsequently reach [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]) without leaving any tracks that it was done for Black Sun. Indeed, soon Clezo informed her that ''[[Slave I/Legends|Slave I]]'' was ambushed by ''[[IG-2000/Legends|IG-2000]]'' and redirected to [[Gall/Legends|Gall]] for repairs.<ref name="sb">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]]<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]'' during that time.</ref> Xizor summoned all his Vigos to [[Xizor's Palace|his Palace]], and they all complied. They all gathered in the antechamber, and were relieved of their weapons by [[Howzmin]]. Everyone knew that Xizor discovered something and wanted to make an example of the culpit to the remaining eight of them. As for Clezo, he was certain that in the meeting Green would be revealed as a traitor, which he knew already; but he would not admit it, as it would be equally serious to know without telling Xizor. He waited patiently until they were summoned by [[Guri]].<ref name="obvious">{{WEGCite|story=The Obvious Scapegoat|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref> Indeed, at the conclusion of the meeting, Clezo witnessed as Xizor had Guri [[Death/Legends|kill]] Green in front of the other Vigos, as a message to any Vigos who would try to sell information.<ref name="guri">{{Topps|set=1996 Topps Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire|cardname=Beautiful... and Lethal|link=https://www.rebelscum.com/photo.asp?image=/sote/soteTC009.jpg}}</ref><ref name="novel">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>

After Xizor's death, Clezo was seen in a Vigo council meeting about the future of the Black Sun. He and [[Wumdi]] did not like when [[Lonay]] started acting as head of the council, and Clezo was not happy seeing an attractive woman supporting him, stating he would not be ordered by some human ''and'' female.<ref name="see3">[[Shadows of the Empire: Evolution 3|''Shadows of the Empire: Evolution'' 3]]</ref>

During a later meeting, the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]] showed up after the human female's invitation. Then the room was invaded by thugs, who were quickly slaughtered. The human female identified the bodies as [[Vekker (Quarren)|Vekker's]] soldiers; nobody knew that the mysterious human who was actually [[Savan]] in disguise, and the one responsible for the attack to incriminate Vekker. Savan claimed that Clezo's and Wumdi's troops would soon be after Vekker.<ref name="see3" />

==Personality and traits==
Clezo was a modest Vigo, less greedy and ruthless than his peers, and ran his criminal operations like businesses. Rather than seeking personal gain, he devoted his ambitions to making Black Sun more powerful. For these traits, Xizor considered him discreet and reliable.<ref name="sb" /> 

Witnessing Xizor's ascension to power to become his master, was a lesson for Clezo, appreciating resourcefulness over swift actions. Taking example, Clezo preferred to plan ahead and expect setbacks. He maintained a large [[database]] of his personnel and contacts and was especially skilled at selecting the proper operative for every service. He endeavored to provide his part of Black Sun with diverse interests and holdings, not limited to specific talents.<ref name="sb" />

His attitude was reflected to his external appearance: he was a subdued, conservative but well-tailored dresser.<ref name="sb" /> He was considered short for his [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Shadow Games">''[[Shadow Games]]''</ref>

==Equipment==
His [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was the ''[[Treasure of Rodia]]'', a [[Dzundo-class star yacht]].
